scope: Combined A+B invariant campaign on integration/risk (CombinedEngine: real Person A + real Person B; book, price feed, oracle, token mocked)

invariants.INV-02: virtual cash + fee/keeper/clearing ledgers == allocationQ; after payouts: LP atoms * Q + treasuryQ == allocationQ, fees in vault escrows
invariants.INV-03: recognized custody <= token custody; market atoms * Q - marketDebitQ == allocationQ
invariants.INV-04: R_y >= Dbar_y + B both outcomes (until reserve residual assigned)
invariants.INV-05: each stored contribution == A order-aware deficits of its own state; sums exact
invariants.INV-06: not a stateful invariant here: admission/withdrawal IM gates are covered by G3/G4 deterministic tests
invariants.INV-07: stopped funding epoch never moves the index (ghost)
invariants.INV-08: positions change only via fills/takeovers (ghost over non-trading actions)
invariants.INV-09: no claim before claims enabled; claimed <= allocated
invariants.INV-10: every account frozen at the one accrual cutoff
